entities.summary: Jody Hull is a Canadian former professional ice hockey winger who serves as the Head coach for the Tri City Americans of the Western Hockey League. He was also head coach of the Peterborough Petes from December 2012 to January 2018. Hull was born in Petrolia, Ontario, but grew up in Cambridge, Ontario.
